<style>
/* ── About Us banner ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Full-bleed photo (images/home/about_us.jpg — EDITABLE, swap
   for any other file in that folder), darkened for text legibility,
   with `background-attachment: fixed` so the photo stays put while the
   page content scrolls over it (a classic parallax feel). Note: fixed
   backgrounds are unreliable on iOS Safari, which silently treats them
   as `scroll` instead — a graceful, harmless fallback, not a bug. */
.about-banner {
  position: relative;
  left: 50%;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: -50vw;
  height: 200px;                    /* EDITABLE: banner height */
  margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: url('/images/home/about_us.jpg') center / cover no-repeat;
  background-attachment: fixed;
}
.about-banner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);   /* EDITABLE: darkness of the photo */
}
.about-banner-title {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  font-family: "Fira Code", "Menlo", "Monaco", monospace;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.2rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.about-intro {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto 4.5rem;
  padding: 0 2rem;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: #333;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ── Shared section headers ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.section-block    { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto 4.5rem; padding: 0 2rem; }
.section-title-bar{ font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #003B5C; margin: 0 0 1.2rem; display: inline-block; }
.board-year-tabs  { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* ── Board Members hex grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   NOTE: this is deliberately only on `.board-hex-panel` (the single
   panel for whichever year is currently selected) and NOT on its
   parent `#boardPanels` — that parent just holds one-or-more
   `.board-hex-panel`s (plus the static 2020-2021 one lives outside it
   entirely as a sibling). Styling both produced a second, empty
   backdrop box wherever the outer wrapper had no visible panel in it. */
.board-hex-panel {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);   /* EDITABLE: backdrop tint */
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
}

.hex-wrap {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(16px);
  transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease;
}
.hex-wrap.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* ── Hex placeholder (before photo loads) ───────────────────────────────── */
.hex-placeholder  { background: var(--hex-color, #2774AE) !important; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; }
.hex-initials     { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.30); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.hex-placeholder .hex-label { opacity: 1; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.28); }
.hex-placeholder .hex-label .hex-name,
.hex-placeholder .hex-label .hex-role { font-size: 0.62rem; }

/* ── Newsletter — simple fading list ─────────────────────────────────────
   A list of volumes, each fading up into place. */
.newsletter-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  max-width: 700px;
}
.newsletter-list-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 59, 92, 0.12);
  text-decoration: none !important;
  color: inherit;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(12px);
  transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}
.newsletter-list-item.is-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.newsletter-list-item:hover { color: #2774AE; }
.newsletter-list-item > a {
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 1rem 0.25rem;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
.newsletter-list-item > a:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #2774AE;
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.newsletter-list-vol { font-family: "Fira Code", "Menlo", "Monaco", monospace; font-weight: 700; color: #2774AE; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.newsletter-list-quarter { font-weight: 600; color: #003B5C; flex: 1; }
.newsletter-list-arrow { opacity: 0.6; flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* ── Responsive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .about-banner { height: 280px; background-attachment: scroll; }
  .section-block { padding: 0 1rem; }
  .board-year-tabs { gap: 0.4rem; }
  .newsletter-list-item > a { gap: 0.75rem !important; }
  .newsletter-list-arrow { font-size: 0.85rem; }
}
</style>

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ABOUT SECTION RENDER SCRIPT — reads BSA_ABOUT and populates the page.
     Unchanged from the old about/about.qmd except the two profile/photo
     URLs below, which dropped their leading "../" (this content used
     to live one folder down, at about/about.html; now it's on the
     site root's index.html).
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var D = window.BSA_ABOUT;

  /* ── Description ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var descEl = document.getElementById('bsaDescription');
  if (descEl) {
    descEl.innerHTML = D.description
      .map(function (p) { return '<p>' + p + '</p>'; })
      .join('');
  }

  /* ── Newsletter — simple fading list ───────────────────────────────────── */
  var nlEl = document.getElementById('newsletterIssues');
  if (nlEl) {
    nlEl.innerHTML = D.newsletter.map(function (issue, i) {
      return '<li class="newsletter-list-item reveal-fade" style="transition-delay:' + (i * 0.12) + 's">' +
        '<a href="' + issue.href + '" target="_blank" style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:1.25rem;width:100%;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;">' +
          '<span class="newsletter-list-vol">' + issue.vol + '</span>' +
          '<span class="newsletter-list-quarter">' + issue.quarter + '</span>' +
          '<span class="newsletter-list-arrow">Read ↗</span>' +
        '</a>' +
      '</li>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ── Slugify a name the same way profile filenames are built ─────────── */
  function slugify(name) {
    return name.toLowerCase()
      .replace(/'/g, '')
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
  }

  /* ── Find a profile path by name, tolerant of number changes ─────────── */
  function findProfilePath(name) {
    var idx = window.BSA_DIRECTORY_INDEX;
    if (!idx) return null;
    // 1. Exact key match (fastest)
    if (idx[name]) return idx[name];
    // 2. Slug-based scan — matches even when the trailing number changes
    var nameSlug = slugify(name);
    var paths = Object.values(idx);
    for (var i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
      var filename = paths[i].split('/').pop(); // e.g. "darren-lin-phd-50"
      if (filename.indexOf(nameSlug + '-') === 0) return paths[i];
    }
    // 3. Fallback: match index key by slug (handles apostrophe/case drift)
    var keys = Object.keys(idx);
    for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
      if (slugify(keys[j]) === nameSlug) return idx[keys[j]];
    }
    return null;
  }

  /* ── Build one hex element ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildHex(member, index) {
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'hex-wrap reveal-fade';
    wrap.style.transitionDelay = (Math.min(index, 8) * 0.1) + 's';

    var initials = member.name === 'Coming Soon' ? 'TBD'
      : member.name.split(' ').map(function (w) { return w[0] || ''; }).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);

    var shapeHTML =
      '<div class="hex-border">' +
        '<div class="hex-shape hex-placeholder" style="--hex-color:' + (member.hexColor || '#2774AE') + ';">' +
          '<div class="hex-initials">' + initials + '</div>' +
          '<div class="hex-label">' +
            '<div class="hex-name">' + member.name + '</div>' +
            '<div class="hex-role">' + member.role + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    var profilePath = findProfilePath(member.name);

    if (profilePath) {
      var profileUrl = 'directory/profiles/' + profilePath + '.html';
      wrap.innerHTML = '<a href="' + profileUrl + '" class="hex-link">' + shapeHTML + '</a>';
      loadPhoto(wrap, profilePath);
    } else {
      wrap.innerHTML = shapeHTML;
    }
    return wrap;
  }

  /* ── Fetch photo from student directory profile ───────────────────────── */
  function loadPhoto(hexWrap, profilePath) {
    var profileUrl = 'directory/profiles/' + profilePath + '.html';
    var progType   = profilePath.split('/')[0]; // phd | ms | mdsh

    fetch(profileUrl)
      .then(function (r) { return r.text(); })
      .then(function (html) {
        var parser = new DOMParser();
        var doc    = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
        var img    = doc.querySelector('img.about-image');
        if (!img) return;

        // src is relative to the profile page (e.g. ../../images/phd/file.jpg)
        var filename = img.getAttribute('src').split('/').pop();
        var imgUrl   = 'directory/images/' + progType + '/' + filename;

        var shape = hexWrap.querySelector('.hex-shape');
        if (!shape) return;
        shape.classList.remove('hex-placeholder');
        var initialsEl = shape.querySelector('.hex-initials');
        if (initialsEl) initialsEl.remove();

        var photo  = document.createElement('img');
        photo.src  = imgUrl;
        photo.alt  = '';
        shape.insertBefore(photo, shape.firstChild);
      })
      .catch(function () { /* keep placeholder on network error */ });
  }

  /* ── Compute balanced row sizes ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  // Rules: no row of 1, rows never decrease toward the bottom.
  // e.g. 7 → [3,4]  |  5 → [2,3]  |  8 → [2,3,3]  |  10 → [3,3,4]
  /* ── Mobile row sizes: strict 2-1-2-1... honeycomb ──────────────────── */
  function computeRowSizesMobile(n) {
    var rows = [];
    while (n > 0) {
      var count = (rows.length % 2 === 0) ? Math.min(2, n) : 1;
      rows.push(count);
      n -= count;
    }
    return rows;
  }

  function computeRowSizes(n) {
    if (n <= 0) return [];

    // 1. Fill rows of 3
    var rows = [];
    var rem  = n;
    while (rem >= 3) { rows.push(3); rem -= 3; }
    if (rem > 0) rows.push(rem);

    // 2. If last row has exactly 1, absorb it into the previous row → max 4
    //    e.g. [3,3,1] → [3,4]  |  [3,1] → [4]
    if (rows.length > 1 && rows[rows.length - 1] === 1) {
      rows.pop();
      rows[rows.length - 1]++;
    }

    // 3. Sort ascending so rows never shrink toward the bottom
    //    e.g. [3,2] → [2,3]  |  [3,3,2] → [2,3,3]
    rows.sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });

    return rows;
  }

  /* ── Build hex grid with smart row layout ─────────────────────────────── */
  function buildHexGrid(members) {
    var grid  = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'hex-grid';

    var isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900;
    var sizes    = isMobile ? computeRowSizesMobile(members.length) : computeRowSizes(members.length);
    var cursor   = 0;
    sizes.forEach(function (size, rowIndex) {
      var rowEl = document.createElement('div');
      // On mobile: no offset class — CSS centering aligns single-item rows to honeycomb midpoint
      rowEl.className = 'hex-row' + (!isMobile && rowIndex % 2 === 1 ? ' hex-row-offset' : '');
      members.slice(cursor, cursor + size).forEach(function (m, i) {
        rowEl.appendChild(buildHex(m, cursor + i));
      });
      cursor += size;
      grid.appendChild(rowEl);
    });

    return grid;
  }

  /* ── Build board tabs + panels ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var tabsEl   = document.getElementById('boardYearTabs');
  var panelsEl = document.getElementById('boardPanels');

  // Dynamic years from data (newest first) + always append 2020-2021
  var years = Object.keys(D.board).sort().reverse();
  years.push('2020-2021');

  years.forEach(function (year, idx) {
    var isFirst = idx === 0;

    /* Tab button */
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className   = 'year-filter-btn' + (isFirst ? ' active' : '');
    btn.textContent = year.replace('-', '–');
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('#boardYearTabs .year-filter-btn')
        .forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
      document.querySelectorAll('.board-hex-panel')
        .forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = 'none'; });
      btn.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('board-' + year).style.display = 'block';
    });
    tabsEl.appendChild(btn);

    /* Panel — 2020-2021 already exists in the DOM as static HTML */
    if (year !== '2020-2021') {
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.id        = 'board-' + year;
      panel.className = 'board-hex-panel';
      panel.style.display = isFirst ? 'block' : 'none';
      panel.appendChild(buildHexGrid(D.board[year]));
      panelsEl.appendChild(panel);
    } else {
      var staticPanel = document.getElementById('board-2020-2021');
      if (staticPanel) staticPanel.style.display = isFirst ? 'block' : 'none';
    }
  });

})();
</script>
```

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Scroll-reveal trigger — plain JS, no external library. Adds
     `.is-visible` to each `.reveal-grow`/`.reveal-fade` element the
     first time it scrolls into view; styles.css handles the actual
     grow/fade transition. Safe to leave alone.

     Observation only starts after the page has been scrolled at
     least once — otherwise, on a short page or a tall viewport where
     the image+text section is already on-screen at load, the browser
     counts that as "already visible" and fires the reveal instantly,
     before the visitor has scrolled to it at all.
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var targets = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal-grow, .reveal-fade');
  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
    targets.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('is-visible'); });
    return;
  }
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (entry) {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
        io.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.2 });

  function startObserving() {
    targets.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  }

  if (window.scrollY > 0) {
    startObserving();
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('scroll', startObserving, { once: true, passive: true });
  }
})();
</script>
```

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Parallax scroll-drift — plain JS, no external library. Any element
     with a `data-parallax-speed="N"` attribute (see the About section
     above) continuously drifts up/down as you scroll, at a rate
     proportional to N and how far its center is from the viewport's
     center. Unlike the reveal effect above, this keeps updating the
     whole time the element is on screen (a "scroll-scrub" effect),
     not just once.
     EDITABLE: the speed numbers live on each element's
     `data-parallax-speed` attribute, not here — e.g. 0.08 is a subtle
     drift, 0.15+ is quite noticeable. Positive drifts down as you
     scroll up past it (and vice versa); negative reverses that.
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var els = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-parallax-speed]'));
  if (!els.length) return;

  var ticking = false;

  function update() {
    var vh = window.innerHeight;
    els.forEach(function (el) {
      var speed  = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-parallax-speed')) || 0;
      var rect   = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      var center = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
      var offset = (center - vh / 2) * speed;
      el.style.transform = 'translateY(' + offset.toFixed(1) + 'px)';
    });
    ticking = false;
  }

  function onScroll() {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
      ticking = true;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
  update();
})();
</script>
```

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Deep-link correction — e.g. clicking "About" in the header, from
     another page, links here to index.qmd#about. The browser tries to
     jump straight to #about as the page loads, but this page's full-
     bleed video starts at height 0 until its metadata finishes
     loading, then snaps to its real height — which can shift #about
     down *after* the browser already jumped, landing short of it. This
     just re-does that jump once everything (video included) has
     actually finished loading.
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
```{=html}
<script>
window.addEventListener('load', function () {
  if (location.hash) {
    var el = document.querySelector(location.hash);
    // `behavior: 'instant'` (not the page's default smooth scroll) —
    // the parallax scroll listener's per-frame work above can fight
    // with and cancel an animated smooth-scroll partway through.
    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'start' });
  }
});
</script>
```
